Name: Discord Rich Presence
Author: RuiNtD
Description:
This mod shows your in-game state on your Discord profile.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*](Recommended) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Install Generic Mod Config Menu.[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Just by having the mod installed, it should work. You can further customize the rich presence in the config menu (using Generic Mod Config Menu) or by editing the config file. If you are editing the config file, these commands should also be useful:
[list]
[*]Type [code]DiscordReload[/code] in the console or press F5 to reload the config.
[*]Type [code]DiscordTags[/code] to view a list of tags you can use for customization.
[*]Use ﻿﻿[code]DiscordFormat[/code] with some text to test out the tags you can use.
[*]Feel free to ping or DM RuiNtD in the [url=https://smapi.io/community]Stardew Valley Discord[/url] if you need help!
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.14 on Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. Host does not need the mod.
[/list][list]
[*]Mac and Linux are untested, but may still work.
[*]Linux requires Discord to be installed as a native app, not as a Flatpak.
[*]Steam Deck is unsupported since SteamOS can't install Discord natively.
[*]Android is unsupported, but may be supported in the future.
[*]Does not and will never work on iOS or console due to the lack of SMAPI.
[/list]

[/list]
